summary.method: Live curl crawl + local codebase inspection; no Playwright, CrUX, GSC, GA4, or backlink APIs available
top_findings: CRITICAL: Live canonicals, robots.txt Host, and sitemap all reference the old domain scamalert.blog, not scamalert360.com
CRITICAL: Deployment disconnect — Hostinger serves old pre-rebrand code; last several commits (rebrand, Next 16, OG images, 4 guides) not live
HIGH: No named author for YMYL E-E-A-T (Organization byline only)
MEDIUM-HIGH: Title tags 82-90 chars and meta descriptions up to 187 chars exceed SERP display limits
quick_wins: Fix Hostinger deployment so scamalert360.com serves the scamalert360 repo (fixes canonicals; ~66 -> ~80)
Use shortTitle for <title> tags to stay under ~60 chars

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with valid Let's Encrypt cert; http->https redirect live (301)
Security headers present: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
Clean URLs, single h1, html lang=en, viewport present, Mediapartners-Google allowed
Static prerender + CDN cache (x-nextjs-cache: HIT); dynamic sitemap and robots

findings.title: Live canonicals point to wrong domain (scamalert.blog)
findings.description: Every live page canonical, plus robots.txt Host and the sitemap URL, reference scamalert.blog. Signals scamalert360.com pages as duplicates of another domain, suppressing indexing/ranking.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the current repo; canonicals already resolve to scamalert360.com in code.

findings.title: Deployment disconnect — stale production code
findings.description: Live site is the old 13-guide 'ScamAlert' (scamalert.blog) build. Recent commits (rebrand, Next 16, HTTPS middleware, OG images, 4 new guides) are on GitHub but not deployed.
findings.recommendation: Confirm Hostinger deploys from github.com/niazr919-source/scamalert360 main and trigger a redeploy; verify a new guide URL returns 200.

findings.title: No favicon / site icons
findings.description: /favicon.ico returns 404 and no app/icon.* exists. Google shows a favicon beside mobile results.
findings.recommendation: Add a branded icon (app/icon.tsx generated at build time).

findings.title: HSTS not present on live responses
findings.description: The HTTPS-redirect middleware (which sets a conservative HSTS header) is not deployed; live redirect appears to be Hostinger's default.
findings.recommendation: Deploy current code to add HSTS.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 17 guides, 1,600-2,900 words, primary-sourced (FTC/IC3/CFPB/Medicare) with visible sources
Non-thin, non-duplicated, useful; tables, checklists, recovery timelines, FAQs
Honest stances (e.g. RFID wallets not worth it); no fabricated credentials

findings.title: No named author (E-E-A-T)
findings.description: All guides use an 'Editorial Team' Organization byline with no verifiable individual. YMYL content is weighted heavily on author expertise.
findings.recommendation: Add a real named author (name + public profile URL); schema/byline already support profileUrl and credentials.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, keyword-aligned titles/descriptions per page
Single h1, logical heading hierarchy, semantic HTML
Strong internal linking (related grids, category cross-links, credit-freeze hub)
OpenGraph and Twitter Card meta present

findings.title: Title tags exceed display length
findings.description: Guide titles run 82-90 chars (e.g. credit-freeze 82, sextortion 90). Google displays ~60. Keyword is front-loaded but the '| ScamAlert360' suffix truncates.
findings.recommendation: Use each article's shortTitle for the <title> tag, or shorten titles.

findings.title: Homepage title is weak
findings.description: 'Scam Awareness & Fraud Prevention Guides' (44 chars) omits the brand and leads with a generic phrase.
findings.recommendation: Lead with brand + primary keyword, e.g. 'ScamAlert360 - Spot Scams, Recover Money & Report Fraud'.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Per-page linked @graph: Article + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage + HowTo; site-wide Organization + WebSite
Article carries wordCount, dates, author, publisher, citations
Author emitted as Organization; no false hasCredential claims

findings.title: Organization author limits author rich results
findings.description: With no named person, author-level rich features are limited.
findings.recommendation: When a real author is added, emit Person with sameAs to their profile.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static prerender + CDN cache; zero content images (strong LCP)
Ad slots reserve height (CLS protection); First Load JS ~103-127 KB

findings.title: No field data available
findings.description: No CrUX/Lighthouse in this environment; scores are lab/inspection estimates.
findings.recommendation: Validate via PageSpeed Insights and Search Console once deployed; watch INP due to the interactive risk-checker.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Semantic HTML, explicit FAQ blocks, primary-source citations aid AI citation
Schema gives machines an unambiguous page read

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.recommendation: Add a concise llms.txt summarizing the site and key guides.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No content images by design -> no alt-text debt, fast pages
Auto-generated OG social images added in codebase (not yet live)

findings.title: No favicon
findings.description: The one real image gap; see Technical.
